IDQ20827
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology

Initial Minor Flood Warning for the Upper Condamine River

Issued at 2:04 pm AEST on Thursday 22 October 2026
Flood Warning Number: 2

Reissued to correct next issue time to Friday afternoon.

MINOR FLOODING POSSIBLE AT WARWICK FROM OVERNIGHT THURSDAY INTO FRIDAY, AT PRATTEN AND
TUMMAVILLE FROM FRIDAY AND CECIL PLAINS FROM SATURDAY

Heavy rain and river level rises have been recorded across the Upper Condamine River and
its tributaries.

River levels at Warwick are rising and minor flooding is possible overnight Thursday into
Friday. The flood water will make its way downstream, with flood levels possibly reaching
minor at Pratten during Friday afternoon, and at Tummaville Friday morning. Minor flooding
is possible from Saturday at Cecil Plains.

Heavy rain is forecast to continue with thunderstorms for the next few days which may
produce multiple flood peaks or prolong the flooding.

Condamine River to Warwick:
Minor flooding possible along the Condamine River to Warwick

The Condamine River at Warwick is currently at 1.04 m and rising, below the minor flood
level. The Condamine River at Warwick may exceed the minor flood level (5.00 m) overnight
Thursday into Friday. The river may reach around 5.20 m Friday morning, with minor
flooding. Further rises are possible.

Condamine River downstream of Warwick to Oakey Creek:
Minor flooding possible along the Condamine River downstream of Warwick to Oakey Creek

No observations are currently available for the Condamine River at Pratten. The Condamine
River at Pratten may exceed the minor flood level (5.50 m) Friday afternoon. The river may
exceed 5.50 m overnight Friday into Saturday, with minor flooding. Further rises are
possible.

The Condamine River at Tummaville is currently at 1.38 m and steady, below the minor flood
level. The Condamine River at Tummaville may exceed the minor flood level (5.00 m) Friday
morning. The river may exceed 6.00 m Friday evening, with minor flooding. Further rises
are possible.

The Condamine River at Cecil Plains is currently at 3.44 m and steady, below the minor
flood level. The Condamine River at Cecil Plains may exceed the minor flood level (6.00 m)
Saturday evening. Further rises are possible.

Safety Advice:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous.
* Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways.
* Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads.
* Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay
informed.
* For local emergency management warnings and advice visit
www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.

For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening
emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

Next issue:
The next warning will be issued by 02:00 PM AEST on Friday 23 October 2026.
